description_en: Submits a copyright watermark extraction job
description_zh: 提交版权水印提取作业
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-copyright-extract-job --input Type=OSS Media=oss://bucket/object --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitCopyrightExtractJob

fields.help_en:
Specifies the URL of an Object Storage Service (OSS) object or the ID of a media asset.
OSS URLs can be in the following formats:

1. oss\://bucket/object

2. http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object

In these formats, `bucket` is the name of a bucket in the same region as your IMS instance, and `object` is the file path
fields.help_zh:
输入文件信息，支持OSS地址和媒资ID两种。
OSS地址规则为

1、oss://bucket/object

2、http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object

其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，object为文件路径
fields.name: media

fields.help_en:
The type of the input file. Valid values:

OSS: The URL of a file in Object Storage Service (OSS).

Media: The ID of a media asset
fields.help_zh:
输入文件类型，取值：
OSS：OSS文件地址
Media：媒资ID
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The video file for watermark extraction.

The region of the Object Storage Service (OSS) file or media asset must match the region of the current Intelligent Media Service (IMS) instance
parameters.help_zh:
待提取水印的视频文件。

OSS文件/媒资的地域需要与当前IMS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The user-defined data. The maximum length is 1,024 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
The watermark job parameters, specified as a JSON string.

algoType: The algorithm type. Default value: v1. The extraction algorithm type must match the algorithm type used for embedding the watermark.

v1: The copyright extraction algorithm for long-form videos.

v2: The copyright extraction algorithm for short-form videos
parameters.help_zh:
水印任务参数，JSONString。目前支持设置参数如下：

algoType：算法类型，默认值为v1。提取算法类型需和嵌入时使用的算法类型一致。

v1：长视频版权提取接口。
v2：短视频版权提取接口
parameters.name: params
